name: Hoa Lu
summary: Walk the Đinh and Lê temples and the tombs on núi Mã Yên. An adult pays 20,000 đồng. A child from 6 to 15, a visitor of 60 or over, and a disabled visitor pay 10,000 đồng. This was the capital of the Đinh, the Tiền Lê, and the early Lý. The festival runs the 8th through the 10th of lunar month 3. Tuyệt Tịnh Cốc is a separate ticket beside the east gate.
getThere: Xã Trường Yên, in the same valley as the Tràng An wharf.
heroCaption: The tomb altar and the steps against the rock at Hoa Lư

notice.title: The cave has its own ticket
notice.body: Tuyệt Tịnh Cốc, also called Động Am Tiên, is 100,000 đồng for an adult and 30,000 đồng for a child under 1.3 m. It sits about 400 m from the east gate of đền Đinh, up 205 steps.

body: This ground was the capital of the Đinh, the Tiền Lê, and the early Lý. The kings named with it are Đinh Tiên Hoàng, Đinh Toàn, Lê Đại Hành, Lê Trung Tông, Lê Long Đĩnh, and Lý Thái Tổ. Đền Đinh stands on the old main hall, about 3 mẫu Bắc Bộ, with núi Mã Yên in front and núi Dù behind. The photograph is the tomb on that mountain: steps up to the altar against the rock.

Đền Lê is a chữ Công plan. Tiền đường is 5 gian. Thiêu hương is 2 gian, 2.8 m by 6.15 m. Hậu cung is 5 gian, 14 m by 6 m. The middle bay holds Lê Đại Hành, the left bay Dương Vân Nga, the right bay Lê Long Đĩnh. The tombs on núi Mã Yên carry steles dated Minh Mệnh 21, which is 1840. Chùa Nhất Trụ holds a stone column dated 995. The ground holds 678 objects and ranks as a special national relic.

The festival is lunar month 3, from the 8th through the 10th, with a large festival every three years. The day is also given as the 10th alone. The hotline is 02293 620 099. The support line is 02293.621.890.

figures.caption: The brick path and the gate at the Temple of Emperor Lê Đại Hành
figures.alt: A wet brick path, festival flags, and a tiled gate at Hoa Lư

gettingThere: Cố đô Hoa Lư is at xã Trường Yên, in the same valley as the Tràng An wharf. Tuyệt Tịnh Cốc is about 400 m from the east gate of đền Đinh, then 205 stone steps, on its own ticket.

legs.heading: From the valley
legs.body: The temples are the morning if you slept near Trường Yên. The east gate is the start for the cave as well.

legs.heading: From Hanoi
legs.body: Train to Ga Ninh Bình, then a ride. The station is kilometre 115 from Hà Nội. SE7 arrives at 08:16.

admissionNote: Adult 20,000 đồng. Child 6–15: 10,000 đồng. Age 60 and over, and disabled visitors: 10,000 đồng. Hotline 02293 620 099. Support phone 02293.621.890. Tuyệt Tịnh Cốc is separate: adult 100,000 đồng, child under 1.3 m 30,000 đồng, hotline 0987807965.
